releases.body:
CI and the publish workflow now run on Node 24 actions (checkout and setup-node v6) instead of the deprecated Node 20 runtime. The post-publish registry check waits up to three minutes. Published from GitHub Actions with npm provenance.

No runtime changes since 1.0.1. Upgrade with `npx parallax-opencode@latest install`.

Fixes the installer exiting silently on macOS and Linux. npx and node_modules/.bin run it through a symlink, and the entrypoint check compared paths without resolving symlinks. Upgrade with `npx parallax-opencode@latest install`.

1.0.1 also carries the 1.0.0 rewrite for OpenCode 1.18.35: seven tools instead of 32, agents and skills loaded straight from the package, and async verification with durable receipts. See CHANGELOG.md for the full list.

releases.name: parallax-opencode v0.7.4
releases.body:
## Horizon full-autonomy liveness

- Removes terminal retry exhaustion for full-autonomy Horizon sessions.
- Adds automatic idle-session continuation while runnable work remains.
- Rotates recovery through correction, replanning, research, and decomposition.
- Adds typed, evidence-backed blockers and trusted cancellation/permission handling.
- Preserves plan/evidence history across safe replanning and prevents cross-session replay.
- Binds sessions to their OpenCode session/workspace and serializes durable transitions.

Verified with 187 tests, coverage, TypeScript, packed artifact smoke, real OpenCode 1.18.4 discovery, and npm audit.

releases.name: v0.6.8 -- Fix CI Coverage Dependency
releases.body:
## Fixed

- CI: added `@vitest/coverage-v8` to devDependencies (required by `vitest --coverage`)

The cross-platform CI matrix (v0.6.7) was failing because `vitest --coverage` requires `@vitest/coverage-v8` which was not listed in `devDependencies`. This is now resolved.

## Upgrade

```bash
npx parallax-opencode@latest
```

releases.name: v0.6.7 -- Cross-Platform CI Matrix
releases.body:
## What's New

### CI/CD
- **Cross-platform testing**: Added Windows and macOS to the CI test matrix
- **6 parallel jobs**: 3 OS (Ubuntu, Windows, macOS) x 2 Node versions (20, 22)
- **fail-fast: false**: Platform failures don't cancel other jobs

### Package Cleanup
- Excluded `scripts/publish.mjs` from npm package (release tool only, users don't need it)
- Added `data/*.png`, `data/*.jpg`, `data/*.jpeg` to .gitignore (screenshot assets)

### Compatibility
- **Windows (x64)**: Confirmed working
- **macOS (Apple Silicon)**: High confidence (99%)
- **macOS (Intel)**: High confidence (99%)
- **Linux (.deb)**: High confidence (99%)
- **Linux (.rpm)**: High confidence (99%)

## Upgrade

```bash
npx parallax-opencode@latest
```

Restart OpenCode to load the updated plugin.
